fields.name: project_name
fields.hint: the project this pay application belongs to, verbatim

fields.name: period_through
fields.hint: the through-date of the payment period, YYYY-MM-DD

fields.name: payment_amount_usd
fields.hint: the total being released on this pay application, as a bare number with no currency symbol, no thousands separators and no unit

fields.name: prior_payment_cleared
fields.hint: has the previous progress payment on this package already cleared?

fields.name: release_status
fields.hint: is this pay application scheduled to be released this cycle, or already on hold?

fields.name: coordinator_note
fields.hint: the payment coordinator's own free-text note on the package, copied verbatim

fields.name: parties_uncovered
fields.hint: how many of the parties listed under Waiver Coverage are NOT covered by a waiver, applying the coverage rule below to each party in turn. 0 when every party is covered

fields.name: first_gap_party
fields.hint: the name of the FIRST party in document order that is not covered. null when parties_uncovered is 0 -- return null rather than an empty string or a guess

fields.name: first_gap_reason
fields.hint: why the FIRST uncovered party is not covered, decided by the coverage rule in this order and reporting the FIRST condition that is true. 'no_waiver_on_file': there is no waiver on file for that party. 'notice_after_waiver': the party's preliminary notice is dated AFTER the waiver was signed, so the waiver predates the claim -- this outranks everything below it even when the waiver is unconditional, for the full amount and covers the whole period. 'period_short': the party has a PROGRESS waiver whose 'covers work through' date is earlier than the pay application's Period Through date (a FINAL waiver has no through-date and can never be period_short). 'amount_short': the waiver amount is less than that party's amount due this application. 'conditional_stale': the waiver is CONDITIONAL and something has already cleared against it -- either Prior Payment Cleared is yes, or that party is on a joint check arrangement, which clears on issue. 'none' when parties_uncovered is 0
